verdict.rationale: Poly documents a hosted MCP server at mcp.poly.app/mcp, confirmed live by a runtime probe. Its tools include search, fetch and a virtual `poly` CLI. Poly also ships a scriptable local `poly` CLI with an agent skill that can search, read, create, update and organize files, plus a Claude Code plugin granting full file access, so an agent can read and write notes such as Mind journal Markdown without the GUI. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent verification of write operations through MCP/CLI, and no public REST/OpenAPI vendor API (first MCP connection also needs a browser OAuth sign-in).
